moments.text: Infrared view looking down on rippled sea, green crosshair at centre, north arrow upper left. Dark smoky patches spread in from the lower right.
The picture flashes white, then dark, then settles on a closer view of the sea.
A small dark spot appears just left of the crosshair and drifts toward the lower left, flickering in and out, as dark patches pass on the right.
After fading for half a second the dark spot returns lower left, then swings right past the crosshair as the view pans, and fades out.
The image washes out to near white and flickers between white and dark grey.
The view jumps to a dark, blurred scene with bright cloud-like shapes as the clip ends.
